items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: So I entered the world of Paul Chambers, of Ron Carter, of Roy Brooks, of you name it.

ctx.x: Well after having graduated from college — well when in the Army I met Kirk Lightsey, who was from Detroit, pianist, who convinced me that I should come to Detroit after college, which is what I did. So I entered the world of Paul Chambers, of Ron Carter, of Roy Brooks, of you name it. And we’re talking about who now? What’s the drummer? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
